name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 25V — SOT
description: Cluster of surface-mount IC linear regulators providing 25V LDO power management in SOT package formats, including the SOT-223-3_TabPin2 footprint.
selection_hints: Select when a 25V LDO linear regulator in an SMD SOT package is required.

avoid_when: Avoid if the PCB layout requires through-hole mounting instead of SMD.

Avoid if non-LDO or non-25V voltage specifications are required.
